scope: Corollary 2.20 (A section detects the projection domain) of the manuscript “Semialgebraic universal covers of normal projective varieties” (preprints/Semialgebraic-universal-covers-of-normal-projective-varieties-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 058 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dd294523779a9237), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose a full-box container D as in Corollary 2.19 is available. A local holomorphic section σ of q avoiding D lies in G at every parameter of S0. Near a boundary point of S0 that lies in the parameter box, S0 is locally pseudoconvex wherever such a section exists.
